sloka: स धनुर् धन्विनाम् श्रेष्ठः प्रगृह्य परम आहवे ।मुमोच परम इष्वासः षट् शरान् अभिलक्षितान् ॥३-२८-२६॥
transliteration: sa dhanur dhanvinām śreṣṭhaḥ pragṛhya parama āhave ।mumoca parama iṣvāsaḥ ṣaṭ śarān abhilakṣitān ॥3-28-26॥

translations.english: The best among archers and a supreme shooter, he lifted the bow, fixed his target and released six arrows in the great fight.
